audit_notes: All 10 performance jobs and all 15 platform jobs succeeded for head 34676fe53c165cd305b7f26f62e7ff1d87427669.

Optimized dev cache replay is 13.024x with identical package/feature/profile graphs across uncached, populate and replay legs. All 31 Cargo units were non-fresh per sample; replay had actual Rust cache hits.

Cache comparison is empty target plus populated local sccache. It excludes network restore/upload, tool installation, daemon startup and target cleanup; these costs are disclosed separately where applicable.
Baseline and candidate cold XAML builds are not 10x faster. Opt-level optimization slows cold WinUI graph by about 10.4%; opt config must remain opt-in or justified by amortized reuse.
9,889 native tests passed with 3 existing ignored tests; each of 3 compiler-cache lanes additionally executed 4,457 selected Controls tests.
Runtime invalidation controls exercise real Cargo/rustc+sccache using a small dependency-free fixture. They do not establish every possible source/build-script edge case in the whole workspace.
The recorded browser timings predate the external-input invalidation fix. That fix requires a separate validation run.
Full platform run wall span includes queuing and different contexts; do not compare it to baseline nightly duration to claim whole-CI speedup.
